text:
Elena (Finance): Quick note after the demo: vendor mentioned pilot credits, blended rates, and a data-processing addendum. Need a mock invoice and a clear mapping of pilot credit consumption. Any procurement leads?
Tom (Procurement): Taking this. Main asks from procurement: 1) sample invoice showing credit applied + amortization; 2) termination and refund terms for partial use of commit; 3) sample PO language.
Randy (VendorRep): Hi team 44b Quick answers: pilot credits apply to the invoice before any commit amortization; we can show both upfront and monthly amortization examples. Termination: pro-rated refunds on unused committed credits if >30-day notice, subject to minimal admin fee.
Sam (Eng): Two technical clarifications: does the vendor store raw payloads from pilot requests? We need to know retention and ability to purge. Also want a per-route performance SLA for chat only.
Randy (VendorRep): We retain payloads for 30 days by default for debugging; we can enable a no-retention mode for pilots (logs only, no raw payload). Per-route SLA for chat is supported; it will be priced as an add-on.
Nisha (Legal): Please send the vendor	DPA draft and confirm data residency for EU traffic. Also need exact SLA credit calc and the dispute window.
Randy (VendorRep): Uploading artifacts: mock-invoice + amortization CSV + DPA draft here: https://vendor.example/docs/RI-pilot-artifacts. SLA credits: monthly credit as percentage of prorated invoice tied to missed p95 windows; dispute window 45 days after invoice.
billing-bot: Billing artifacts received and queued (ticket BI-7721).
Elena (Finance): Can you paste a tiny mock line-item showing how the $10k pilot credit hits the invoice? Small code block would be ideal.
Randy (VendorRep): Sure, quick mock snippet:
```
Monthly invoice: $12,000
Pilot credit: -$10,000
Commit amortization (monthly): $2,000
Amount due: $4,000 (after credit applied -> then amortization)
Note: if prepaid commit chosen, invoice shows upfront $12k with pilot credit applied as credit memo.
```
Tom (Procurement): Helpful. Procurement also wants an overage cap option (e.g., cap at 150% of commit for first 3 months) while we tune traffic. Is that possible?
Randy (VendorRep): Yes we can add an overage cap for pilot customers; can do a temporary cap for the first 90 days.
Sam (Eng): We'll run a short load test during pilot. One ask: can vendor provide a CSV of per-route latencies and byte usage daily? That helps our cost map.
Randy (VendorRep): We can provide daily CSV with per-route token counts and latencies. I'll include sample schema in the artifacts link.
Nisha (Legal): Legal will review DPA + SLA. If finance/proc want specific refund wording, drop a short paragraph here and I'll fold it into the contract.
Elena (Finance): Please include a clause: "Pilot credits are applied prior to commit amortization; unused pilot credits expire after 90 days. In case of early termination initiated by vendor, remaining credits will be refunded pro rata." Can legal tweak?
Nisha (Legal): Noted. Will propose language for vendor counsel.
Tom (Procurement): Action items: vendor to share mock invoice + CSV + DPA (Randy), procurement to draft PO template (me), legal to review DPA/SLA (Nisha), finance to model cashflow scenarios (Elena). Timeline: artifacts by Tue EOD, internal review Wed.
Randy (VendorRep): I'll upload everything by EOD Tue and am available for a 30m walkthrough Wed morning.
Elena (Finance): Thanks. Closing thread 44d
